decks.notes: This Boros Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creature plays paired with disruptive spells to control the board and outpace the opponent. Containment Priest and Guide of Souls help manage opposing graveyard strategies, while Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Voice of Victory provide additional threats and pump up the team. Deafening Silence and Static Prison disrupt the opponent's game plan, allowing the deck to push through damage efficiently. The deck aims to maintain board presence and pressure the opponent without relying on a specific combo or key card.

The main concept of this deck is to assemble the combo of Nomads en-Kor, Cephalid Illusionist, and Shuko to mill the entire library, while having Narcomoeba in play to trigger when the library is empty. This allows for Thassa's Oracle or Memory's Journey to win the game. The deck focuses on protecting the combo pieces with cards like Force of Will and using cantrips like Brainstorm and Ponder to find the pieces needed. Urza's Saga is used to find key artifacts like Shuko or Prismatic Ending for removal.

The deck focuses on assembling the Cephalid Breakfast combo to win the game. By using cards like Nomads en-Kor and Cephalid Illusionist to mill the library, players can then use Thassa's Oracle or Nadu, Winged Wisdom to win the game on the spot. The deck also includes protection cards like Force of Will and Swords to Plowshares, as well as card draw and filtering with Brainstorm and Ponder. Additionally, Urza's Saga helps to find combo pieces or utility lands like Cavern of Souls.

The main concept of this deck is to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy while continuously applying pressure with efficient creatures and removal spells. The tempo of the game is dictated by utilizing cards like Thoughtseize, Daze, and Force of Will to disrupt the opponent's plays, while creatures like Nethergoyf and Murktide Regent provide a quick clock to end the game. This deck aims to outpace the opponent with a combination of disruption and aggression, taking advantage of the Dimir color identity's strengths in control and tempo strategies.

The main concept of this UWx Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan with removal spells and counterspells while also generating card advantage through cards like Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Snapcaster Mage. The deck also aims to control the board with cards like Back to Basics and Swords to Plowshares while also having the ability to lock down the opponent's mana base with cards like Magus of the Moon. Additionally, the deck utilizes powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler to provide additional value and control over the game state.

This deck focuses on using a variety of control spells to disrupt your opponent's game plan while maintaining card advantage and tempo. It utilizes counterspells like Force of Will and Flare of Denial, removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Prismatic Ending, and card draw like Brainstorm and Ponder. The deck also includes creatures like Snapcaster Mage and Plagon, Lord of the Beach for value and threats. Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student provides additional card advantage and control. Overall, the deck aims to control the game until it can establish a dominant position and win.

The main concept of this UWx Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan through counterspells, removal, and disruptive cards like Back to Basics and Magus of the Moon. The deck aims to control the tempo of the game by using cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student to draw cards and gain card advantage. By creating a favorable board state with cards like Thundertrap Trainer and Forth Eorlingas! while disrupting the opponent's strategy, this deck seeks to outlast and outmaneuver its opponent until it can secure a victory.

This deck focuses on using lands as a resource to control the game, creating a lock on the opponent's abilities and resources while generating value. It utilizes cards like Sphere of Resistance and Crop Rotation to slow down the opponent, along with powerful lands like Dark Depths and Thespian's Stage for win conditions. The deck also includes utility lands like Maze of Ith and Bojuka Bog to deal with threats and disrupt the opponent's strategy. By effectively managing resources and utilizing land synergies, this deck aims to outlast and outmaneuver opponents in a long game.

The main focus of this Mono Black Aggro deck is to disrupt the opponent's hand and graveyard while applying pressure with aggressive creatures. The deck utilizes cards like Thoughtseize and Hymn to Tourach to strip away the opponent's resources, while cards like Dark Confidant and Barrowgoyf provide a steady stream of threats. Reanimate and Animate Dead allow for powerful graveyard recursion, and Cecil, Dark Knight and Dauthi Voidwalker offer additional ways to disrupt the opponent's game plan. With efficient removal like Fatal Push and strong mana acceleration from Dark Ritual and Chrome Mox, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly and decisively.

The main focus of this Legacy Combo deck is to quickly bring out powerful creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Atraxa, Grand Unifier using cards like Show and Tell and Omniscience. The deck utilizes various protection spells like Force of Will and Veil of Summer to ensure the combo is successful, while also including cards like Cunning Wish and Lórien Revealed for versatility and card advantage. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with its powerful creatures and spells, leading to a quick victory.

The deck focuses on assembling the Painter's Servant and Grindstone combo to mill the opponent's entire library in one turn. It contains multiple ways to protect and accelerate this combo, along with card draw and artifact synergies to maintain consistency. The goal is to control the board while setting up the combo pieces, eventually leading to a game-winning mill. The inclusion of Urza's Saga provides additional utility and flexibility in fetching crucial artifacts. This deck is designed to quickly execute its win condition and disrupt the opponent's game plan effectively.

The deck revolves around quickly generating mana through various accelerants and casting spells to build storm count. Using cards like Lion's Eye Diamond and Dark Ritual, the player aims to cast their key cards such as Ad Nauseam or Tendrils of Agony to either draw their deck or drain the opponent's life total. The deck also utilizes Wishclaw Talisman to tutor for key pieces, while disrupting the opponent with Duress and Thoughtseize. The goal is to assemble the necessary pieces for a lethal storm turn and win the game in one explosive combo.

The deck focuses on assembling a critical mass of fast mana sources and card draw spells to storm off and win the game in a single turn. It utilizes cards like Lion's Eye Diamond and Lotus Petal to generate mana quickly, alongside rituals like Dark Ritual and Cabal Ritual to further accelerate the combo. The deck also includes tutors like Infernal Tutor and Burning Wish to find key combo pieces, while disruption in the form of Duress and Thoughtseize help protect the deck's game plan. The win condition is typically achieved through casting Tendrils of Agony for lethal damage.

Utilize powerful reanimation spells like Reanimate and Animate Dead to quickly bring back high-impact creatures like Griselbrand, Archon of Cruelty, and Atraxa, Grand Unifier. Control the game with disruptive spells like Force of Will, Daze, and Thoughtseize while using card draw and selection spells like Brainstorm and Ponder to find key combo pieces. Use the versatile Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student to generate card advantage and protect your game plan. Make use of dual lands and Wastelands to ensure mana consistency and disrupt opponent's mana base.

The deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures, then using reanimation spells like Reanimate and Animate Dead to bring them back onto the battlefield for a big advantage. It includes disruption in the form of counterspells like Force of Will and Daze, as well as hand disruption with cards like Thoughtseize. The deck also has some versatile threats like Brazen Borrower and Atraxa, Grand Unifier to apply pressure and control the game. The main strategy is to efficiently cheat powerful creatures into play while disrupting the opponent's plans.
